DESCRIPTION

There is a standard type current socket on the tunnel console next to the handbrake which can be used for the cigar lighter or for connecting instruments or equipment operating on 12 V.

The cigar lighter heater coil can be located in the front socket in the console; simply press the knob to operate it: after a few seconds it will come out automatically, ready for use.

The ring around the socket lights up when the side lights are on.

See E2535 CONTROL LIGHTS

The socket is equipped with a thermal protection device: this protection cuts off the power supply if devices that absorb a lot of energy are connected.

The circuit for the two current sockets in the console is protected by a specific fuse and controlled by the ignition-operated exclusion relay located in the junction unit under the dashboard. To prevent the battery from being run down, these sockets are ignition-operated (INT/A).
